description: This file is a shell script that performs a series of tests on a command-line tool called 'test-tool'. It sets up various test cases to validate command execution, error handling, parallel execution, environment variable passing, and other behaviors related to command running capabilities within a testing framework.

methods.name: test_trace
methods.description: A helper function that runs 'test-tool run-command' with tracing enabled, captures the output, and compares it against an expected trace string.
